newsitem.title: USA: Great Western reviews Ahmanson bid.
newsitem.headline: Great Western reviews Ahmanson bid.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp president and chief executive officer John Maher Tuesday confirmed the thrift received an unsolicited bid from H.F. Ahmanson and Co and said it was reviewing the offer.
"Great Western will respond to H.F. Ahmanson when it has had an opportunity to fully review and evaluate this proposal with its board of directors and advisors," he said.
Great Western said it received Monday evening an unsolicited merger proposal from H.F. Ahmanson under which each share of Great Western stock would be converted into 1.05 shares of Ahmanson stock.
